sentences.text:
Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State of U.P./opposite party no.1 and perused the record.

By means of this application, the applicant has prayed for expeditious disposal of case being Complaint Case No. 841 of 2021 (Soni Saini Vs. Rajan Saini and others), under Sections 323, 504,
506, 498A IPC, Police Station Mariyahun, District Jaunpur pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, Court No. 12, Jaunpur within a time bound frame.

sentences.text: At the outset, learned Additional Government Advocate submits that till date, accused-opposite party no. 1 did not appear before the trial Court, therefore, the prayer of the applicant, who is complainant in this case, seeking direction to expedite the trial of the accused cannot be granted at this stage.

Learned counsel for the applicant does not dispute the aforesaid fact as pointed out by learned A.G.A. and in reply submits that the applicant may be permitted to withdraw this application with liberty to file fresh application at the appropriate stage.

In view of the above, this Court finds force in the preliminary objection/submission of learned A.G.A. for the State that without appearance of accused before the trial Court, no direction to expedite the trial of the accused within time bound period can be issued.

However, having regard to the statement given by learned counsel for the applicant at the Bar, this application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to the applicant to file fresh application at the appropriate stage, after appearance of accused before the trial Court.
Office is directed to return the certified copy of the documents, if any, to the counsel for the applicant after retaining xerox copy of the same on record as per rules.

Order Date :- 16.8.2023 Shubham  Smt. Soni Saini vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165930207/
